source_detail: programs code/kummer_dump.c and code/to_rows.py in three-row/ of github.com/arhancanli/quantavane-covering-arrays (MIT, commit 984c4cb), run as kd 4 0 dump.txt then python3 to_rows.py dump.txt out.txt (no search; rebuilds this file byte for byte); checks and logs in three-row/checks/
construction: Covering perfect hash family from two copies of PG(2,q), q = 4^s: columns (x, x^-1, x) (the Raaphorst-Moura-Stevens pair) and (x, b x^-1, b x) with b^3 a non-cube of GF(q); here q = 16
notes: CPHF(3; 546, 16, 3); every set of three columns checked by two separately written programs (kummer3.c, singer_check.c) and by tools/cphf/cphfcheck.c in mode full; the construction holds for every q = 4^s (proof sketched in the linked README; a note is in preparation)
